2607.15178.title: T^2MLR: Transformer with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence
2607.15178.paper_summary: Transformer reasoning is limited by autoregressive decoding, which repeat edly compresses rich hidden computation through token space and makes it difficult for intermediate reasoning states to persist across time. We in troduce Transformers with Temporal Middle-Layer Recurrence (T2MLR), a transformers-based latent reasoning architecture that fuses a cached middle layer representation from the previous token directly into an earlier layer of the current token position, enabling abstract intermediate computation to persist across decoding steps with little inference overhead. Across natural-language pretraining and multi-hop reasoning finetuning, T2MLR consistently outperforms data- and parameter-matched Transformer base lines. Moreover, applying recurrence to only a localized middle-layer block (as little as 20% of the network) often outperforms full-layer recurrence. Im portantly, T2MLR does not require pretraining from scratch: retrofitting the recurrent pathway into an existing pretrained 1.7B Transformer and briefly finetuning substantially improves math reasoning, lowering the barrier to practical adoption. These results suggest that effective latent reasoning in Transformers does not require looping over all layers as in previous works, but can instead emerge more strongly from targeted middle-layer recurrence.
2607.15178.paper_summary_zh: Transformer 推理受到自回歸解碼的限制，這會反覆地通過標記空間壓縮豐富的隱藏計算，並使得中間推理狀態難以在時間上持續存在。<lb/>我們引入了具有時間中層重複的 Transformer（T2MLR），這是一種基於 Transformer 的潛在推理架構，將來自前一標記的緩存中層表示直接融合到當前標記位置的早期層中，使得抽象的中間計算能夠在解碼步驟中持續存在，且幾乎不增加推理開銷。<lb/>在自然語言預訓練和多跳推理微調中，T2MLR 始終超越數據和參數匹配的 Transformer 基準。<lb/>此外，僅對局部中層區塊（僅 20% 的網絡）應用重複，往往會超越全層重複。<lb/>重要的是，T2MLR 不需要從頭開始進行預訓練：將重複路徑安裝到現有的預訓練 1.7B Transformer 中並簡短微調，顯著改善了數學推理，降低了實際採用的門檻。<lb/>這些結果表明，Transformer 中有效的潛在推理不需要像以往的研究那樣遍歷所有層，而是可以更強烈地從有針對性的中層重複中出現。
